description: Toolchain update policy for Portable Web Toolkit sites and starters. Versions are never pinned here; the resolver picks the newest set whose peerDependencies and dependencies agree (so TypeScript stays on 6.x while @astrojs/check peers ^5 || ^6, and lifts itself the day a release allows 7).

notes.anchors: Packages the rest of the set is solved around. They stay at the newest version that every other direct dependency can support; an integration that lags a new major holds the anchor on the previous major and says so.
notes.holds: Last resort for a reason peers cannot express: { "pkg": { "range": "^1", "reason": "why" } }. Prefer fixing the cause; every hold is printed in every report.
notes.ignore: Package names the updater must never touch.
notes.acceptPeerConflicts: User-approved risk: [{ "package": "typescript", "owner": "@astrojs/check", "reason": "why this is acceptable, who approved, and when to re-check" }]. Ignores what `owner` declares about `package`, so the newer major is allowed even though the owner does not claim support. Printed in every report until removed.
notes.minimumReleaseAgeHours: Releases younger than this are never written into a range (pnpm 12 refuses them with ERR_PNPM_MINIMUM_RELEASE_AGE_VIOLATION). A project's pnpm-workspace.yaml minimumReleaseAge (minutes) wins; 0 disables.
